overview.title: CW-02: two-axis benchtop coil winder
overview.description: Agent-authored concept reproducing wire-to-helix transformation with human loading, cutting and unloading. Schema validation is not physical validation.

requirements: Constrain wire to a removable cylindrical mandrel
Maintain adjustable tension without damaging wire
Synchronize traverse distance with spindle turns to control pitch
Release and collect the coil with recoverable scrap separated
requirements.power_needs: 12 V motion supply and regulated 5 V camera-host/control supply; budget 25–40 W active, 5–12 W released idle
physical_constraints: One benchtop workcell; concept geometry only
safety_notes: Provide a guarded winding zone and stop/interlock before hardware operation; electrical wiring remains undesigned.
missing_info: Actual wire diameter, temper and surface requirements
Final coil diameter, pitch, turn count, lead lengths and tolerances
